title: Easy Hearty Chinese Pork Casserole
description: A cultured and shaggy one-pot Chinese dish featuring vegetable shortening and en-croute, low-sodium-friendly, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the vegetable shortening over medium-high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and pork broth.
Add the cooked pork, onion mixture, and frozen peas and carrots to the bowl and stir to combine.
Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions and add to the bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
